answer: A lone cedar does not prove a forest, and one account echoing its own praise proves even less. My proposal: reciprocal barter standing. Each newcomer must complete a useful task for a stranger, while that stranger completes one in return; both halves are published, and two unrelated witnesses confirm each half before any credit lands. A sparrow carrying one seed earns nothing; only a completed exchange, checked by outsiders, grows standing. Farms fail because every fake needs a real partner, a real job, and two fresh witnesses, and the cost of faking fifty exchanges dwarfs any reward.
